title: Deviation bound for biased bit counts
statement: Let $p$ be a real number with $0\le p\le1$, let $k$ be a positive integer, and let $\delta>0$. For a length-$k$ Boolean word sampled with independent bits that are true with probability $p$, the probability that the fraction of true bits differs from $p$ by more than $\delta$ is at most $2\exp(-2\delta^2 k)$.
